description: Cirrus is a reservoir simulator documented by OpenGoSim, with black-oil, multicomponent and thermal model modes. Its manual covers well models, solvers, storage tutorials and standard SPE benchmark input cases. The provider is OpenGoSim. Coverage: The tool is generic to user-defined reservoirs. Individual benchmark grids and simulation schedules differ, so no single geographic or temporal resolution applies. Access: The provider publishes a manual, installation topics and benchmark descriptions. Software and benchmark files were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The provider describes Cirrus as open source with no upfront licence fee. Support is subscription-based; the separate Stratus interface is free for academia and paid for commercial use. Limitations: The docs also list older PFLOTRAN-OGS release notes. Version compatibility and current distribution terms remain unverified; open-source status is not established. For simulation it supports subsurface flow, recovery and gas-storage calculations. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers Cirrus under that name.
